lenses.name: Alpha persistence minimality
lenses.guide: Review persisted compaction and replay data for one global simplification. This extension is alpha and has zero backward-compatibility requirement. Preserve current compaction, restart, fork, and replay behavior for data written by the current implementation. Ask which persisted fields and compatibility branches are required to validate and replay a checkpoint, and which only preserve an older representation or duplicate derivable facts. Prefer one current schema and the smallest self-validating record. Delete obsolete compatibility or unused lineage when this reduces reasoning and verification surface. Do not weaken identity, digest, active-branch, or exact-segment checks. Do not add migration code, a schema framework, a new module, or generic persistence abstraction. Report one coherent simplification, not a local defect or style issue.
